tools.name: list_pdf_tools
tools.description: List every DocuGrip tool that is live: id, name, one line on what it does, and its page. Use this to see what is available.

tools.name: find_pdf_tool
tools.description: Find the DocuGrip page that does a PDF or document task, described in the user’s own words — for example "combine two contracts", "black out account numbers", "my scan has no searchable text" or "shrink this under 2 MB". Returns the matching tools, each with its page. Use this when the user wants to

tools.name: plan_pdf_job
tools.description: Turn a PDF job with several steps — for example "merge these scans, compress to 4 MB for IRCC and add a password" — into ordered steps, each with the DocuGrip page that does it. Also returns how many runs the job takes, the daily allowance, and which DocuGrip plan fits when the job, a batch of files

tools.name: get_pdf_tool
tools.description: Get one DocuGrip tool by its id, for example "merge-pdf".

tools.name: get_plans
tools.description: List DocuGrip plans with their current price, billing terms, who each plan suits, and where to buy. Use this when the user asks what DocuGrip costs, whether they need to pay for a task, or which plan fits them.

tools.name: get_upload_requirements
tools.description: Look up the official file size limit and accepted format for an upload portal or service (for example IRCC, USCIS, ImmiAccount, CM/ECF, Gmail, Turnitin, Etsy) with the official source and the date it was checked, plus a compressor page already set to a safe target size. tools.name: find_official_form
tools.description: Find an official form (US IRS and USCIS, Canada, UK and more), such as W-9, W-4, 1099-NEC, I-130, I-765 or N-400, with the issuing agency source, the current edition and the date older editions are rejected, plus a page to fill and sign it in the browser. findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "plan_pdf_job" references sensitive artifacts (password). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.
